properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWTs. Must match the value used by auth-service.

properties.name: auth-service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the auth-service, used by AuthServiceClient (Feign).

properties.name: wallet-service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the wallet-service. WalletServiceClient calls POST /internal/transfer on it to move rent and utility payments from the tenant's wallet to the property owner's wallet.

properties.name: listing-service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the listing-service, used for Feign client calls.

properties.name: booking-service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the booking-service, used for Feign client calls.

properties.name: app.api-key
properties.description: Internal API key sent as the X-API-Key header on service-to-service calls: to wallet-service /internal/** endpoints (WalletServiceFeignConfig) and to auth-service internal lookups. Must match auth-service's key and wallet-service's internal.api-key (INTERNAL_API_KEY). No default: if it is blank, those calls are rejected with 401.

properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend application. Used as the button link (e.g. 'Open Premisave', 'Pay this bill') in the emails sent by EmailService and PaymentNotificationService.

properties.name: notifications.email.from
properties.description: Address emails are sent from (EmailService): payment receipts, deposit and utility bill emails, failed-payment notices and owner-written notices. Independent of the SMTP login configured under spring.mail.username.

properties.name: notifications.email.from-name
properties.description: Display name shown on the email From line and in the header and footer of every email (EmailService).

properties.name: notifications.email.support-address
properties.description: Support contact shown as a mailto link in the footer of every email (EmailService).

properties.name: utility.rates
properties.description: Utility rates in USD charged per unit of metered consumption, keyed by utility type (e.g. utility.rates.electricity, utility.rates.water). Used to auto-generate bills from meter readings (UtilityBillingService). Utility types with no rate need an explicit ratePerUnit on the request.

properties.name: service-health.enabled
properties.description: Turns the availability checks on auth-service and wallet-service on or off (ServiceHealthMonitor). When on, endpoints marked @RequiresServices answer 503 'service offline' before doing any work if a required service is unreachable.

properties.name: service-health.auth.path
properties.description: Path on auth-service probed to decide whether it is online. Any HTTP answer except 502/503/504 counts as online, so the path may be protected or missing.

properties.name: service-health.wallet.path
properties.description: Path on wallet-service probed to decide whether it is online. Any HTTP answer except 502/503/504 counts as online, so the path may be protected or missing.
